# Backing Up and Restoring OrderHub Desktop

OrderHub Desktop can back up its whole setup every day: printers, routing, exceptions, Prepress templates and settings. If the lab PC fails, or you move to a new one, you can bring everything back in a few minutes instead of setting it all up again.

* Note: This is only for **OrderHub Desktop** on your lab PC. **OrderHub** itself runs online, and its orders, customers and settings are looked after by Pixfizz, so there's nothing to back up there.

---

## What's in a backup

| Backed up | Not backed up |
|---|---|
| Connection details (except passwords), download folder, printers and controllers, routing, Channel Mappings, Process Folder Exceptions, Prepress templates, Film Scans, File Uploads and Order XML settings, and the Order XML customer list | Passwords and API keys, the Jobs list, and the Activity Log |

* Note: Prepress templates are backed up from version **1.19.1**. Older backups don't include them.

---

## Setting up backups

Do this on every lab PC that runs OrderHub Desktop.

1. Go to **Settings → Backup** and tick **Enable automatic daily backups**.
2. **Backup folder**: click **Browse...** and choose a folder on another machine, ideally a network share such as `\\NAS\OHD-Backups\`.
   * Note: Network paths starting `\\` are the most reliable. Mapped drive letters can be missing when OrderHub Desktop starts with Windows.
   * Note: Several PCs can use the same folder. Each one keeps its backups in its own sub-folder.
3. **Include Order XML customer directory**: leave this ticked unless your lab doesn't allow customer names and emails on the backup share.
4. Click **Save Settings**, then **Backup Now**, and check that **Last backup** shows the time.

![OHD Backup settings](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/8ac4d2b7-23be-4e2b-9814-1ff036b01e50.png)

**When backups happen:** once a day, when OrderHub Desktop starts or when you first save a setting that day, and whenever you click **Backup Now**. The last 30 backups are kept.

* Note: If a backup fails, for example because the network folder is offline, the reason shows on the **Last backup** line, and OrderHub Desktop tries again next time.

---

## Before you restore

* **Use version 1.19.1 or later on the PC you're restoring to.** Earlier versions could fail to start after a restore. Download the latest version from **OrderHub → Settings → Info**.
* **Have your passwords to hand.** Backups never contain them: the OrderHub **API Key**, the **FTP Password**, and the **S3 Secret Access Key** and **Topaz API Key** if you use them.

---

## Moving to a new PC

When the old PC still works:

1. **Finish the Jobs list on the old PC.** Send or complete every job that's waiting.
   * Note: Once a PC has downloaded a job, OrderHub won't send it to another PC, so anything left waiting won't appear on the new one.
2. Click **Backup Now** (**Settings → Backup**) and check that **Last backup** shows the time.
3. Quit OrderHub Desktop from the tray icon, and untick **Launch on Windows startup** (**Settings → General**) so it can't start again by itself.
4. Restore on the new PC (below).

* Note: **Never run OrderHub Desktop on both PCs at once.** Both would download and send the same work.

---

## After a PC fails

1. Get the new or repaired PC ready and restore on it (below).
2. Jobs the old PC had downloaded but not sent won't come through to the new PC. Check OrderHub for jobs still showing **Received**, and contact Pixfizz support about them.

---

## Restoring

1. Install OrderHub Desktop on the new PC.
2. Go to **Settings → Backup** and set **Backup folder** to the same folder the old PC used.
3. Click **Restore from Backup…** and pick the newest backup.
   * Note: If the new PC has a different name from the old one, click **Browse backups from other machines** to see the old PC's backups.
4. Check the summary, leave every section ticked, and click **Restore**. Confirm when asked.
5. Click **Restart now**.

![OHD Restore](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/d900b369-9278-45c7-b53b-399e7db4f97d.png)

**After the restart:**

1. Go to **Settings → Connection**, re-enter the **API Key**, the **FTP Password** and any other passwords, and click **Test Connection** in each section.
2. **Check the folders.** The restore brings back the old PC's folder paths: the **Download Directory**, your controllers' output folders and any hot folders. Make sure each one exists on this PC, especially if drive letters are different.
3. Tick **Launch on Windows startup** (**Settings → General**).
4. Click **Save Settings**. OrderHub Desktop starts checking for jobs.

---

## Good to know

* **Same PC name as the old one?** The first time the new PC backs up, OrderHub Desktop may say the backup folder belongs to another machine. Once the old PC is gone for good, choose **Take over this folder**.
* **Test a restore once,** for example on a spare PC, so you know it works before you need it. Don't let the test PC download jobs: don't enter the API key, or turn off **Download new orders automatically** first.
